After that the pull coin of the contract, this one, will be swapped with the token to buy and the token to buy will be sent to the contract so not in your wallet but directly into the contract. Regarding the sale it will be the same. So bot will send the details on the contract and from the contract token to this case token address here will be swapped to the pool coin selected, this one, and then the pool coin will be sent to the contract. Lets trade now! We will pick the CAKE token address and we will put it into the bot. We must select the number guey to use for trade. So we set 15. Geey in the bot and then parking spot the right RPC and start the bot. Sending details to top contract here. Sending details successful. Snapping done. And by transaction worked correctly. Now we can stop the bot. Let's see what happened. We have to pick the contact address from the config file and we search it into the bsc scan and you can see here the transactions so this one is the details sent to the contract this one is our swap so you can see a way and the trade the amount of tokens are all in the contract now. Let's see how to withdraw into my wallet. You can see the current contract balance here. Now, we have to send this balance into our wallet. Just click here, Send token to my wallet. And sending token back successful. So you can see here, zero. And let's see what happened token transferred from the contract to my wallet you can also send back the pool coin contract into your wallet just click here send poolcoin to my wallet you can also send back the pool coin contract into your wallet just click here the pool coin is the selected here and click here Let's see what happened the pool coin rapid bnbB is sent back to my wallet, from the the contract obviously all these moves can be done with any coin keep in mind that when you sent the pool coin to the contract using the pay coin the pay coin will be sweeped into the pool coin and then will be sent to the contract
